info.description: Backend API for Crimpy climbing training application
info.title: Crimpy API

get.description: Retrieve all coach accounts awaiting admin validation

put.description: Reject a pending coach account, revert it to a normal user and notify the coach by email (admin only)

200.description: Coach rejected successfully, with email_sent reporting whether the notification was delivered

400.description: Invalid user ID or user is not a coach

put.description: Approve a pending coach account and notify the coach by email (admin only)

200.description: Coach validated successfully, with email_sent reporting whether the notification was delivered

400.description: Invalid user ID, user is not a coach, coach already validated or email not verified

get.description: Retrieve all users in the system (admin only)

delete.description: Delete a user from the system (admin only)

400.description: Invalid user ID or cannot delete admin

get.description: Retrieve all assessment results for the authenticated user, ordered by session date descending
get.summary: Get all assessments for the current user

post.description: Create a new assessment result for the authenticated user, linked to an existing session they own
post.summary: Create an assessment linked to an existing session

delete.description: Delete an assessment. User must own the associated session.

put.description: Change password for authenticated user or admin changing another user's password

403.description: Only admins can change other users' passwords

get.description: Retrieve all custom weight overrides for the authenticated user
get.summary: Get all builtin training weight overrides

post.description: Create a custom weight override for a builtin training
post.summary: Create a builtin training weight override

put.description: Update custom weights. User must own it.
put.summary: Update a builtin training weight override

delete.description: Delete a custom weight override. User must own it.
delete.summary: Delete a builtin training weight override

get.description: Retrieve all assessments for a user enrolled with the authenticated coach.

403.description: Not a coach or user not enrolled

get.description: Get all training programs created by this coach for a specific client.

403.description: Not a validated coach or client not enrolled

post.description: Create a program for an enrolled client. Requires a validated coach account.
post.summary: Create a training program for a client

403.description: Not a validated coach or client not enrolled

get.description: Get a specific program by ID.

put.description: Replace program metadata. Only the owning coach can update.

delete.description: Delete a program and its weeks. Only the owning coach can delete.

get.description: Get all explicitly defined weeks for a program (summary, no sessions).
Get a specific week with its sessions and per-item overrides.

put.description: Upsert a week's sessions and overrides. Existing sessions for the week are replaced.
put.summary: Create or replace a program week

delete.description: Delete a week and all its sessions/overrides (cascade).

get.description: Retrieve all sessions for a user enrolled with the authenticated coach.

403.description: Not a coach or user not enrolled

get.description: Retrieve a specific session with its rep data and assessments for a user enrolled with the authenticated coach.

200.description: Session details with rep_datas and assessments

403.description: Not a coach or user not enrolled

404.description: Session not found or does not belong to client

post.description: Generate a one-time enrollment link token (valid 7 days). Requires a validated coach account.

get.description: Get all users enrolled under the authenticated coach.

delete.description: Remove a user from the coach's enrolled clients.

404.description: User not enrolled by this coach

get.description: Get paginated exercises in the authenticated coach's library, with optional name and tag filters.

post.description: Create a new exercise in the coach's exercise library. Requires a validated coach account.

get.description: Get all exercises marked as favorite in the authenticated coach's library.

post.description: Assign a tag to an exercise. Both must belong to the authenticated coach.
post.summary: Assign a tag to an exercise

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

delete.description: Remove a tag from an exercise. Both must belong to the authenticated coach.
delete.summary: Unassign a tag from an exercise

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

get.description: Get a specific exercise by ID. Only accessible by the owning coach.

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

put.description: Update an exercise in the coach's library. Only the owning coach can update.

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

delete.description: Delete an exercise from the coach's library. Only the owning coach can delete.

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

put.description: Mark or unmark an exercise as favorite. Only the owning coach can update.

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

get.description: Get all tags in the authenticated coach's library.

post.description: Create a new tag in the coach's tag library. Requires a validated coach account.

put.description: Update a tag in the coach's library. Only the owning coach can update.

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

delete.description: Delete a tag from the coach's library. Only the owning coach can delete. Automatically unassigns from all exercises.

403.description: Not a validated coach or not owner

get.description: Validate a token and return the coach's info. Used before accepting enrollment.

post.description: Accept a coach enrollment using a one-time token.

400.description: Token expired, already used, or user already enrolled

get.description: Retrieve all pinned builtin trainings for the authenticated user

post.description: Pin a builtin training for the authenticated user

delete.description: Remove a pinned builtin training for the authenticated user

get.description: Retrieve all sensor configs for the authenticated user

post.description: Create a new sensor calibration configuration for the authenticated user

put.description: Update a sensor config. User must own it.

delete.description: Delete a sensor config. User must own it.

get.description: Retrieve all training sessions for the authenticated user, each with its rep count

post.description: Create a new training session for the authenticated user with optional rep data and assessments

403.description: Training or program session not available to the user

get.description: Retrieve a specific session by ID with all related rep data and assessments. User must own the session unless they are an admin.

200.description: Session details with rep_datas and assessments

put.description: Update a session's name, notes, and duration. User must own the session unless they are an admin.

delete.description: Delete a session. User must own the session unless they are an admin.

get.description: Get all training templates for the authenticated user (without items).

post.description: Create a new training template with a structured item tree.

get.description: Get a training template with its full item tree. Only the owner can access.

put.description: Replace the training metadata and items tree. Only the owner can update.

delete.description: Delete a training template and all its items. Only the owner can delete.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's information from their JWT token
Get the coach the authenticated user is currently enrolled with.

delete.description: Remove the authenticated user from their current coach enrollment.

get.description: Get all programs assigned to the authenticated user by their coach.
Get a specific program assigned to the authenticated user.
get.summary: Get one of my training programs

get.description: Get the full training tree for a training scheduled in a program assigned to the authenticated user. Authorized through program ownership rather than training ownership.
get.summary: Get a training referenced by one of my programs

get.description: Get all defined weeks for a program assigned to the authenticated user.
get.summary: List weeks of one of my programs

get.description: Get a specific week with sessions and overrides for a program assigned to the authenticated user.
get.summary: Get a week from one of my programs

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token
Revoke a refresh token. Always succeeds so clients can clear local state.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token. The refresh token is rotated: the old one is revoked and a new one is returned.
Create a new user account with email and password
Resend verification email with a 10-minute cooldown per email

400.description: Invalid request or email already verified

post.description: Verify user email using the token sent via email

date.description:
Only logged sessions send a date. Omitted, the stored one is kept, which is
what played sessions rely on since their date is fixed by the run.

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
